Our licensed technicians respond quickly to active nests in this quiet Bronx neighborhood.

faqs.question: How quickly can you treat a wasp or hornet nest in my Pelham Gardens home?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day or next-day service in Pelham Gardens depending on availability. faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Pelham Gardens?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: Will wasps or hornets return after you treat the nest?
faqs.answer: Once the nest is treated and all entry points are sealed, recolonization at that location is prevented. Every service includes a service agreement — terms depend on the service and are confirmed on the call.
